title: Samson and Delilah

questions.question: Where did Samson carry the gates of Gaza to?
options: The top of the hill that is in front of Hebron
questions.correctAnswer: The top of the hill that is in front of Hebron
questions.explanation: Judges 16:3 (ESV): "...and carried them up to the top of the hill that is in front of Hebron."

questions.question: What was the name of the woman Samson fell in love with?
questions.explanation: Judges 16:4 (ESV): "...he loved a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah."

questions.question: What did the Philistine lords offer Delilah?
questions.explanation: Judges 16:5 (ESV): "...and we will each give you 1,100 pieces of silver."

questions.question: What was the real secret of Samson's strength?
options: He was a Nazirite and no razor had touched his head
questions.correctAnswer: He was a Nazirite and no razor had touched his head
questions.explanation: Judges 16:17 (ESV): "...for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother's womb. If my head is shaved, then my strength will leave me..."

questions.question: What did the Philistines do to Samson after capturing him?
options: Gouged out his eyes and bound him with bronze shackles
questions.correctAnswer: Gouged out his eyes and bound him with bronze shackles
questions.explanation: Judges 16:21 (ESV): "And the Philistines seized him and gouged out his eyes and brought him down to Gaza and bound him with bronze shackles..."

questions.question: How many times did Delilah ask Samson for his secret before he told the truth?
options: Four times (he told her on the fourth)
questions.correctAnswer: Four times (he told her on the fourth)
questions.explanation: Judges 16:6, 10, 13, 15 (See narrative flow: fresh bowstrings, new ropes, hair woven, and finally the truth).

questions.question: What was the first lie Samson told Delilah?
options: If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried
If they bind me with new ropes
If you weave the seven locks of my head
questions.correctAnswer: If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried
questions.explanation: Judges 16:7 (ESV): "...If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, then I shall become weak..."

questions.question: What god were the Philistines offering a sacrifice to?
questions.explanation: Judges 16:23 (ESV): "...to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god and to rejoice..."

questions.question: What did Samson do in prison?
questions.explanation: Judges 16:21 (ESV): "...and he ground at the mill in the prison."

questions.question: How many people were on the roof of the temple?
questions.explanation: Judges 16:27 (ESV): "...and on the roof there were about 3,000 men and women..."

questions.question: What did Samson ask the young man to do?
options: Let me feel the pillars on which the house rests
questions.correctAnswer: Let me feel the pillars on which the house rests
questions.explanation: Judges 16:26 (ESV): "...Let me feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean against them."

questions.question: Where was Samson buried?
options: Between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah
questions.correctAnswer: Between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah
questions.explanation: Judges 16:31 (ESV): "...and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father."

questions.question: What phrase describes how Delilah pestered him?
options: She pressed him hard with her words day after day, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed to death
questions.correctAnswer: She pressed him hard with her words day after day, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed to death
questions.explanation: Judges 16:16 (ESV): "And when she pressed him hard with her words day after day, and urged him, his soul was vexed to death."

questions.question: Did Samson kill more people at his death or in his life?
questions.explanation: Judges 16:30 (ESV): "...So the dead whom he killed at his death were more than those whom he had killed during his life."

questions.question: What lie involved weaving the seven locks of his head?
options: Into the web and fastening it tight with the pin
questions.correctAnswer: Into the web and fastening it tight with the pin
questions.explanation: Judges 16:13-14 (ESV): "...If you weave the seven locks of my head with the web and fasten it tight with the pin..."

key_verse_text: Then Samson called to the LORD and said, “O Lord GOD, please remember me and please strengthen me only this once...” (ESV)
